LANDING.HERO_DESC: Platform operations UI for the event backbone: browse dead-letter records, inspect enriched failure payloads, and replay messages back to JetStream. Business events from every service land in Postgres via NATS ingest; poison messages that exhaust retries are published to the separate DLQ stream for ops triage.
LANDING.CARD_ANGULAR: Angular 21 with signals, strict TypeScript, and Module Federation into the shell — standalone on port 4002 or hosted at `/event-store`.
LANDING.CARD_PRIMENG: PrimeNG 21 + Aura (`eventStoreAuraPreset`) for toolbar tabs, cards, dialogs, and theme tokens aligned with the shell.
LANDING.CARD_I18N: @ngx-translate JSON catalogs (en/de); locale maps to `Accept-Language` on gateway-proxied event-store API calls.
LANDING.CARD_AUTH: angular-oauth2-oidc with PKCE; Google and Microsoft sign-in via the Go gateway. Ops routes require an admin role before prod rollout.
LANDING.CARD_GATEWAY: Go API gateway: OAuth token exchange, internal JWT, reverse proxy to `/api/event-store/*` with owner and correlation headers.
LANDING.CARD_EVENT_STORE: Fastify + TypeScript: pull ingest from JetStream `EVENTS` into Postgres, DLQ API (`GET /dlq`, `POST /dlq/:id/replay`), and event query endpoints.
LANDING.CARD_PLATFORM_NATS: platform-nats repo owns JetStream topology (`EVENTS` + `DLQ` streams, durables, `max_deliver`). Apps connect only — reconcile before consumers start.
LANDING.CARD_POSTGRES: Postgres tables `events` and `dlq_records` with JSONB payloads; retention jobs trim rows independently of JetStream `max_age`.
LANDING.CARD_NATS: JetStream: stream `EVENTS` holds durable business subjects; stream `DLQ` holds poison traffic — topology from platform-nats, separate from normal ingest.

FLOWS.PICKER_ARIA: Choose which flow diagram to explore

INGEST_FLOW.SUBTITLE: Click a block for detail. Happy path: a platform service publishes a standard envelope to JetStream `EVENTS`; event-store pull-ingests into Postgres for audit and query — never mixed with DLQ traffic.
INGEST_FLOW.DIAGRAM_ARIA: Event ingest flow: select a step to read details
INGEST_FLOW.NOTE: Invalid envelopes on ingest are terminated — they do not go to the DLQ stream. JetStream replay buffer and Postgres TTL are independent retention knobs.
INGEST_FLOW.PANEL_EMPTY: Tap a step: publisher, JetStream EVENTS, event-store ingest, or Postgres events table.

PUBLISHER.TITLE: Platform publisher
PUBLISHER.DESC: chatbot-service, file-service, api-gateway, and future services emit the standard event envelope after a durable write.
PUBLISHER.D2: Envelope: id, type, service, entity_id, owner_id, correlation_id, timestamp, payload.
PUBLISHER.D3: Failed publish → service-local Postgres outbox until JetStream is back.

NATS.TITLE: JetStream · EVENTS stream
NATS.DESC: Durable fan-out buffer for business subjects only — explicit includes per service prefix, not a catch-all that would swallow `events.dlq.>`.
NATS.D2: Pull durables per consumer (`event-store-ingest`, domain handlers, …).
NATS.D3: Topology reconciled from platform-nats before apps start.

INGEST.TITLE: event-store ingest
INGEST.DESC: Pull durable `event-store-ingest` on `EVENTS` only — validates envelope, writes to Postgres, explicit ack.
INGEST.D1: Bounded fetch batches; idempotent on event `id`.
INGEST.D2: Valid envelope → `events` row with JSONB payload.

POSTGRES.TITLE: Postgres · events
POSTGRES.DESC: Queryable audit store — the source of truth for `GET /events` filters (type, service, entity, owner, correlation, time range).
POSTGRES.D1: Indexed columns for common ops filters.
POSTGRES.D2: `pnpm retain` trims rows by `EVENTS_RETENTION_DAYS` — separate from JetStream age.
POSTGRES.D3: Events tab in this UI calls gateway → `GET /api/event-store/events`.

DLQ_FLOW.SUBTITLE: Click a block for detail. DLQ is an ops pattern — not a third datastore technology. After `max_deliver`, domain consumers publish enriched failure records to `events.dlq.<sink>`, ack the poison message, and event-store persists them for triage and replay.
DLQ_FLOW.DIAGRAM_ARIA: DLQ ops pattern flow: select a step to read details
DLQ_FLOW.NOTE: Replay republishes the stored envelope to the original subject on `EVENTS` — event-store does not call other services over HTTP. Domain consumers must stay idempotent.
DLQ_FLOW.PANEL_EMPTY: Tap a step: domain consumer, max_deliver, DLQ publish, DLQ ingest, Postgres dlq_records, or this ops UI.

CONSUMER.TITLE: Domain pull consumer
CONSUMER.DESC: file-service cleanup, event-store ingest, and other durables — explicit ack after successful handling.
CONSUMER.D1: Pull from `EVENTS` with a service-specific filter.

MAX_DELIVER.TITLE: Retries exhausted
MAX_DELIVER.DESC: When the handler cannot succeed within broker-configured delivery attempts, the consumer must not leave the message pending forever.
MAX_DELIVER.D2: Final failure path: enrich + publish to DLQ subject.
MAX_DELIVER.D3: Not the same as business ingest failures (those use outbox or term).

PUBLISH.TITLE: DLQ publish
PUBLISH.DESC: Publish enriched record to `events.dlq.<logical-sink>` on stream `DLQ`, then ack the original JetStream message.
PUBLISH.D1: Payload carries original subject, correlation_id, owner_id, last_error, optional stream metadata.
PUBLISH.D2: Ack clears the poison message from the consumer's pending set.
PUBLISH.D3: Subject pattern: `events.dlq.>` — never ingested as a normal business row.

INGEST.TITLE: event-store DLQ ingest
INGEST.DESC: Separate pull durable `event-store-dlq-ingest` on stream `DLQ` — never attached to `EVENTS`.
INGEST.D3: Business ingest consumer never reads the DLQ stream.

POSTGRES.TITLE: Postgres · dlq_records
POSTGRES.DESC: Ops table backing `GET /dlq` — filter by sink, correlation_id, time; tracks `replayed_at`.
POSTGRES.D1: List + detail API for the DLQ tab in this UI.
POSTGRES.D2: Longer retention default (`DLQ_RETENTION_DAYS`) than business events.
POSTGRES.D3: Replay stores envelope for republish to `EVENTS`.

OPS_UI.TITLE: This ops UI
OPS_UI.DESC: Admin-gated Angular remote — browse DLQ rows, inspect failure context, trigger replay when safe.
OPS_UI.D3: 409 when already replayed; 400 when envelope missing.

EVENTS_PAGE.TITLE: Events
EVENTS_PAGE.SUBTITLE: Query ingested business events from Postgres. Filter by service, type, entity, owner, or correlation ID, then open a row for the full JSON payload.
EVENTS_PAGE.EMPTY_HINT_FILTERED: Try clearing filters or widening the date range.
EVENTS_PAGE.EMPTY_HINT_UNFILTERED: Events appear here after services publish to JetStream and event-store ingests them.
EVENTS_PAGE.ERROR_LOAD: Could not load events. Check the gateway and event-store service, then try again.

DLQ_PAGE.TITLE: Dead letter queue
DLQ_PAGE.SUBTITLE: Inspect messages that exhausted JetStream retries or failed final handling. Filter by sink, open detail, and replay when the root cause is fixed.
DLQ_PAGE.EMPTY_FILTERED: No DLQ records match your filters
DLQ_PAGE.EMPTY_HINT_FILTERED: Try clearing filters or widening the date range.
DLQ_PAGE.EMPTY_HINT_UNFILTERED: Records appear here after a consumer exhausts retries and publishes to the DLQ stream.
DLQ_PAGE.ERROR_LOAD: Could not load DLQ records. Check the gateway and event-store service, then try again.

DETAIL.SUBJECT: DLQ subject
DETAIL.NO_ENVELOPE: No envelope stored — replay is not available for this record.

REPLAY.CONFIRM_MESSAGE: This republishes the stored envelope to {{subject}} on the EVENTS stream. Domain consumers must handle the message idempotently. Continue?
